judgment.rationale: The reported locked-screen behavior is documented and intentional. The report does not establish a failure while unlocked; do not propose bypassing the security/lock-screen power behavior.
evidence: The reporter uses indefinite Awake with Keep screen on and observes the lock-screen display timeout on several PCs.
Microsoft Learn explicitly states Keep screen on applies only while unlocked; locking restores normal display timeout behavior.
Checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/powertoys/awake, including its Getting started and Keep screen on notes.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/awake/Awake/Core/Manager.cs: SessionSwitch updates IsScreenLocked and ComputeAwakeState receives the lock state.
judgment.recommended_action: Retain the evidence-based explanation; no product fix is proposed.

fix_assessment.rationale: The observed lock-screen display timeout is documented supported behavior, not a demonstrated product defect.
